361: but the Guru's teaching is profound and unequalled. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching, liberation and the supreme state are obtained;
ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the True Lord Himself comes to dwell in the mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Through the Guru's teaching, the world is saved,
if one embraces love and affection for it.
How rare is that person who embraces love and affection for it!
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Through the Guru's teaching, eternal peace is obtained. ॥2॥
Through the Guru's teaching, the gate of salvation is found.
One who serves the True Guru becomes a support for his family.
One who has no Guru has no salvation.
Plundered by faults, such people suffer blow after blow. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, the body finds peace and tranquillity.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਤਾ ਕਉ. ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
The messenger of death does not come near him.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in the True Lord. ॥4॥1॥40॥
One who dies in the Word sheds self-conceit from within.
He serves the True Guru, and has not even an iota of greed.
The Fearless Lord, the Great Giver, ever abides in his mind.
The True Bani of the Word is obtained only by good destiny. ॥1॥
So gather virtues, and let your faults depart from within;
ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
you shall be absorbed in the Word of the perfect Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਸੋ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
One who purchases virtues knows their value;
through the ambrosial Word, he chants the Name.
Through the True Bani, he becomes pure.
Through virtue, the Name is obtained. ॥2॥
Priceless virtues cannot be acquired by any price.
They come into the pure mind, absorbed in the True Word.
Very fortunate are those who meditate on the Name,
and ever enshrine in their minds the Giver of virtue. ॥3॥
ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ; ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to those who gather virtues.
At the Gate of Truth, I sing the praises of the True One.
He Himself bestows His gifts, spontaneously.
O Nanak, the value of such a one cannot be described. ॥4॥2॥41॥
Great is the greatness of the True Guru;
He unites with the Lord those who have been separated for so long.
He Himself unites them in His union.
He Himself knows His own worth. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
How can anyone appraise the Lord's worth?
ਹਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ. ਮਿਲੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Lord is infinite, inaccessible and incomprehensible; through the Word of the Guru, a rare person meets Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Only a rare Gurmukh knows His worth;
how rare are those who receive Him by His grace!
Through the sublime Bani of His Word, one becomes sublime.
Rare is the Gurmukh who chants the Word. ॥2॥
Without the Name, the body suffers pain and anguish;
but when one meets the True Guru, that pain is removed.
Without meeting the Guru, the mortal earns only pain.
The self-willed receive only more punishment. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ; ਅਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
The essence of the Lord's Name is so very sweet;
he alone drinks it in, whom the Lord causes to drink.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
By the Guru's grace, the essence of the Lord is obtained.
O Nanak, imbued with the Name, salvation is attained. ॥4॥3॥42॥
My God is true, deep and profound.
Serving Him, the body finds peace and tranquillity.
Through the Word, His humble servants easily swim across.
ਤਿਨ ਕੈ; ਹਮ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
I fall at their feet forever. ॥1॥
362: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Those whose minds are imbued with the Lord's love —
ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ; ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
their pain of birth and death is removed; they are lovingly admitted to the Court of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who tastes the Word obtains the true flavour;
he enshrines the Lord's Name in his mind.
The Lord God is eternal and all-pervading;
He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away. ॥2॥
Everyone talks and speaks through speech;
the Lord Himself forgives, and unites us with Himself.
By merely speaking and talking, He is not obtained;
by the Guru's grace, He comes to abide in the mind. ॥3॥
The Gurmukh eradicates his self-conceit from within;
he is imbued with the Lord's love, having discarded worldly attachment.
He contemplates the utterly immaculate Word of the Guru.
O Nanak, through the Name, he becomes able to embellish the lives of others. ॥4॥4॥43॥
Attached to the love of duality, one suffers in pain.
Without the Word, one's life is wasted in vain.
Serving the True Guru, understanding is obtained,
and then one is not attached to the love of duality. ॥1॥
Those who remain attached to the root are accepted.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਹਰਿ. ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Night and day, they meditate within their hearts on the Lord's Name; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they know the One Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who is attached to the branches does not obtain the fruit.
For blind actions, one receives blind punishment.
The blind, self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest.
ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ; ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੨॥
He is a maggot in manure, and in manure he shall rot away. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Serving the Guru, everlasting peace is obtained.
Joining the true congregation, one sings the glorious praises of the Lord.
One who contemplates the Name, ever absorbed in the Name,
saves himself, and saves his family as well. ॥3॥
Through the Guru's Bani, the Name resounds within;
O Nanak, through the Word, one finds the mansion of the Lord's presence within one's own home.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
Under the Guru's instruction, bathe in the pool of truth, in the water of the Lord;
thus the filth of evil-mindedness and all sins shall be washed away. ॥4॥5॥44॥
The self-willed die a spiritual death; dying so, they spoil even their death,
for in the love of duality they destroy their own spiritual life.
Crying "mine, mine", the self-willed one is ruined;
ਆਤਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑੈ; ਭਰਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
he never examines his own soul, and sleeps on in doubt. ॥1॥
He dies an honourable death who dies through the Word.
ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ. ਗੁਰਿ, ਸਮ ਜਾਣਾਈ; ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ, ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru has taught him to see praise and slander as alike; in this life he earns the profit, chanting the Lord's Name, and departs. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Without the Name, one wastes away in the rounds of the womb.
Life is wasted in vain, lured by duality.
Without the Name, the whole world burns in pain.
The perfect True Guru has given this understanding. ॥2॥
The fickle mind suffers blow after blow.
Missing this chance, one finds no place of rest.
The cycle of womb and birth is a dwelling in filth;
in that home the self-willed one dwells. ॥3॥
ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru.
He merges the Gurmukh's light into the Supreme Light.
Through the pure Bani, one dwells in one's own true home.
O Nanak, he conquers his ego and remains forever detached. ॥4॥6॥45॥
The Lord's servant has effaced his own separate identity;
363: he dedicates his body and mind, and seeks the sanctuary of the True Guru.
His great glory is that the Name dwells in his heart —
the Name of God, the Beloved, who is forever his companion. ॥1॥
He alone is the Lord's true servant who remains dead to desires while yet alive.
ਸੋਗੁ ਹਰਖੁ ਦੁਇ. ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He looks upon sorrow and joy alike; by the Guru's grace, through the Word, he is saved. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The deed he is to do has been ordained from the Lord's Court:
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ; ਕੋ. ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
without the Word, no one is accepted.
Singing the Lord's praises and enshrining the Name — this is his deed.
The Lord Himself gives this gift, without delay. ॥2॥
The self-willed world goes astray in doubt.
Without capital, it carries on a false trade.
ਵਿਣੁ ਰਾਸੀ; ਵਖਰੁ ਪਲੈ. ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Without capital, one gains no merchandise.
Gone astray, the self-willed one wastes his life. ॥3॥
One who serves the True Guru is the Lord's true servant.
Lofty is his status, and lofty is his life.
ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ; ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Climbing the Guru's ladder, he becomes the highest of all.
O Nanak, greatness comes through the Name. ॥4॥7॥46॥
The self-willed soul-bride practises falsehood, nothing but falsehood;
ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ; ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
she never attains the Mansion of her Husband Lord.
Attached to duality, she wanders astray in doubt.
Bound by possessiveness, the world comes and goes. ॥1॥
O mind, look at the adornments of the discarded bride — mere show and corruption.
ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤਿ ਧਨਿ, ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ; ਝੂਠੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
So too, whoever fixes his consciousness on children, spouse, wealth and Maya — all that attachment is false, hypocrisy and corruption. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
She who is pleasing to God is forever a happy soul-bride.
She makes the Guru's Word her adornment.
Her bed is comfortable; night and day she enjoys her Lord.
Meeting her Beloved, she obtains everlasting peace. ॥2॥
ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਚੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
She is a truly fortunate soul-bride, who loves the True Lord.
ਅਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ; ਸਦਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
She keeps her Husband Lord always clasped to her heart.
She sees Him near, ever present with her.
To her, my God is pervading everywhere. ॥3॥
Neither social class nor beauty go with one hereafter.
As are the deeds one does, so does one become.
Through the Word, one becomes the highest of the high;
O Nanak, such a one merges in the True Lord. ॥4॥8॥47॥
The Lord's humble servant, imbued with devotion, abides in intuitive poise and love.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ; ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Living in reverence of the Guru, he is absorbed in the Truest of the true.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ; ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Without the perfect Guru, there is no devotion.
The self-willed weep and repent, having lost their honour. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
O my mind, chant the Lord's Name, and ever meditate on Him.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਜੋ ਇਛੈ. ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You shall be in bliss forever, day and night, and obtain whatever fruit you desire. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Through the perfect Guru, the Perfect Lord is obtained,
and one enshrines the Word, the True Name, in the heart.
Bathing in the pool of ambrosial nectar, one becomes pure within.
Absorbed in the True One, people become pure forever. ॥2॥
He beholds the Lord God ever present with him.
By the Guru's grace, he sees Him pervading everywhere.
Wherever I go, there I see Him.
ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
Without the Guru, there is no other giver of this gift. ॥3॥
The Guru is the ocean, the inexhaustible treasure-house,
of precious jewels and countless gems of praise.
By the Guru's grace, the Great Giver bestows them.
O Nanak, the Forgiving Lord forgives. ॥4॥9॥48॥
The Guru is the ocean; the True Guru is the embodiment of the True One.
By perfect good fortune, one serves the Guru.
364: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself inspires to understand;
by the Guru's grace, He has him serve. ॥1॥
Through the jewel of spiritual wisdom, all understanding is obtained.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ. ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ, ਵੇਖੈ, ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace, ignorance is dispelled; one remains awake night and day, and beholds the True Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Through the Guru's Word, he burns away attachment and pride;
from the perfect Guru, he obtains true understanding.
Through the Guru's Word, he recognises the Lord's Mansion within.
ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹੈ; ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੨॥
His coming and going cease; he becomes steady, absorbed in the Name. ॥2॥
For the self-willed, the world is only birth and death.
The self-willed one is heedless, in the pitch darkness of attachment to Maya.
He slanders others and practises utter falsehood.
ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ; ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
He is a maggot in manure, and in manure he remains absorbed. ॥3॥
Joining the True Congregation, one obtains all understanding.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, devotion to the Lord is implanted within.
One who accepts the Lord's Will is ever at peace;
O Nanak, he is absorbed in the True Lord. ॥4॥10॥49॥
One who dies in the Word finds everlasting bliss.
He meets the True Guru, the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.
ਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
He does not die again, nor does he come and go.
Through the perfect Guru, he merges in the True Lord. ॥1॥
ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ; ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
Those who have the Name written as their preordained destiny —
ਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
night and day they meditate forever on the Name; from the perfect Guru they receive the mark of devotion. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Those whom the Lord God unites with Himself —
ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ; ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
their profound spiritual state cannot be described.
The perfect True Guru has given them this glory,
the highest state, absorbed in the Lord's Name. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
"Whatever He does, He does by Himself;
in an instant He establishes and disestablishes" —
one who merely says this again and again, telling it to others,
ਜੇ ਸਉ ਘਾਲੇ; ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
is not accepted, even if he labours a hundred times. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ; ਤਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Those who have merit in their account, the Lord unites with the Guru.
The Guru recites to them the True Bani, the Word.
ਜਹਾਂ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ; ਤਹਾਂ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
Where the Word abides, pain departs.
Through the jewel of spiritual wisdom, one is absorbed in the True One, in intuitive poise. ॥4॥
ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ; ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
No other wealth is as great as the Name.
It is given only to the one whom the True Lord blesses.
Through the perfect Word, he enshrines it in his mind.
O Nanak, imbued with the Name, he finds peace. ॥5॥11॥50॥
One may dance and play many instruments,
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਬੋਲਾ ਹੈ; ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
but this mind is blind and deaf, so to whom is he speaking and preaching?
Within him are greed and doubt, like fire and wind;
the lamp of wisdom does not burn, and he obtains no understanding. ॥1॥
Through devotion as Gurmukh, the heart is illumined.
ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ; ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Examining one's own self, one meets that God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Gurmukh's dance is to embrace love for the Lord;
to keep the beat is to shed one's ego from within.
My True God Himself becomes his friend;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
through the Guru's Word, recognise the Lord within. ॥2॥
Through devotion as Gurmukh, love and affection well up within.
The Guru's Word brings intuitive poise and contemplation.
Devotion as Gurmukh is the true way to meet Him;
hypocritical devotion and dance bring only pain. ॥3॥
365: This is true devotion: that the Lord's servant remains dead to Maya while yet alive,
and by the Guru's grace crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥
Devotion done according to the Guru's teaching is accepted,
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ; ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੪॥
and the Dear Lord Himself comes to dwell in the mind. ॥4॥
When the Lord grants His grace, He unites one with the True Guru.
ਨਿਹਚਲ ਭਗਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Then one's devotion is unwavering, and one's consciousness is attached to the Lord.
Those imbued with devotion are blessed with true glory.
O Nanak, imbued with the Name, peace is obtained. ॥5॥12॥51॥

One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
By the Lord's Will, one meets the True Guru, and the True Lord and true understanding are obtained.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
He alone knows the Lord, in whose mind the Lord comes to dwell by the Guru's grace. ॥1॥
ਮੈ. ਸਹੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
My Husband Lord is the One Giver; I have no other at all.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace, He comes to dwell in the mind, and then there is lasting peace. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ, ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ; ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
In this age, the Lord's Name is what frees one from fear; it is obtained by reflecting on the Guru's teaching.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Without the Name, the self-willed, blind fool is in the grip of death. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ. ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ; ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
By the Lord's Will, His humble servant serves Him, and understands the True Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ; ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਨਿਐ. ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
By the Lord's Will, He is praised; accepting His Will, peace is obtained. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ. ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਈ ॥
By the Lord's Will, one attains the purpose of this precious human life, and the intellect is exalted.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੫੨॥
O Nanak, praise the Name; as Gurmukh, one is emancipated. ॥4॥39॥13॥52॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
You are the Creator, the Eternal True One, my Lord and Master.
ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ; ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ. ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whatever pleases You, that alone comes to pass; whatever You give, that alone I receive. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All are Yours; all meditate on You.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਤਿਨਿ. ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Those upon whom You show mercy obtain the jewel of the Name.
The Gurmukh finds it, and the self-willed loses it.
You Yourself separate, and You Yourself unite. ॥1॥
ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ; ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
You are the river; all are within You.
Other than You, there is no one at all.
All beings and creatures are Your play.
Through separation, the united are separated; through union, they are united again. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ. ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
That humble being alone understands, whom You inspire to understand;
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
he ever speaks and chants the Lord's glorious praises.
ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
One who serves the Lord obtains peace;
he is intuitively absorbed in the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ; ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
You Yourself are the Creator; all that happens is Your doing.
ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Without You, there is no other.
ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ; ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
You create the creation and watch over it, and You alone understand it.
O servant Nanak, all this is revealed to the Gurmukh. ॥4॥1॥53॥
366: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ; ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Some form alliances with friends, children and brothers.
ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ; ਕੁੜਮ ਸਕੇ. ਨਾਲਿ ਜਵਾਈ ॥
Some form alliances with in-laws, relatives and sons-in-law.
ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ; ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ. ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਈ ॥
Some form alliances with chiefs and leaders for their own selfish ends.
My alliance is with the Lord, who is pervading everywhere. ॥1॥
ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ; ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
I have formed my alliance with the Lord; the Lord is my only support.
ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ, ਪਖੁ ਧੜਾ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ. ਅਸੰਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Other than the Lord, I have no faction or alliance; I sing His countless, endless glorious praises. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਧੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ; ਸੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Those with whom you form alliances shall pass away.
Making false alliances, people repent in the end.
ਥਿਰੁ. ਨ ਰਹਹਿ; ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
They do not remain here forever, yet they practise deceit in their minds.
ਹਮ. ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
I have formed my alliance with the Lord, whose equal in power there is none. ॥2॥
ਏਹ ਸਭਿ ਧੜੇ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
All these alliances are the expanse of Maya and attachment.
For the sake of Maya, the fools quarrel.
They are born and die, and lose the game of life in the gamble.
ਹਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ; ਜਿ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
My ally is the Lord, who embellishes all, here and hereafter. ॥3॥
ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਧੜੇ; ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਝਗੜਾਏ ॥
In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the five thieves stir up factions and quarrels;
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
sexual desire, anger, greed, attachment and pride have increased.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
One upon whom the Lord shows mercy, He unites with the True Congregation.
ਹਮਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਧੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੪॥
My ally is the Lord, who has destroyed all these factions. ॥4॥
ਮਿਥਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ; ਧੜੇ ਬਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
False love of duality sits within and creates factions.
ਪਰਾਇਆ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਅਟਕਲੈ; ਆਪਣਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ ॥
One searches out the faults of others, and only inflates one's own ego.
As one plants, so does one eat.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ. ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਧਰਮੁ; ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੫॥੨॥੫੪॥
Servant Nanak's ally is the Lord; this is his righteous faith, through which one can conquer the whole world. ॥5॥2॥54॥
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ; ਮਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Listening again and again in the heart, the Ambrosial Name became pleasing to my mind.
Through the Guru's Bani, I have seen the unseen Lord. ॥1॥
As Gurmukh, listen to the Name, O my sisters.
ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ. ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ. ਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The One Lord is pervading within every heart; with your mouths, utter the ambrosial words of the Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੈ. ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ; ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
My mind and body are filled with divine love and a great longing.
By great good fortune, I have found the True Guru, the Primal Being. ॥2॥
In the love of duality, people wander after the poison of Maya.
The unfortunate ones do not find the True Guru. ॥3॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
The Lord Himself has given me to drink the ambrosial essence of the Lord.
Through the perfect Guru, O Nanak, I have found the Lord. ॥4॥3॥55॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Love for the Lord fills my mind and body; the Name is my support.
I chant the Name; the Name is the essence of peace. ॥1॥
Chant the Name, O my friends and companions.
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ. ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Name, I have no other; by great good fortune, the Gurmukh obtains the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Without the Name, one cannot truly live.
By great good fortune, the Gurmukh obtains the Lord. ॥2॥
Those who lack the Name have their faces blackened by Maya.
Without the Name, cursed, cursed is their life. ॥3॥
367: ਵਡਾ ਵਡਾ ਹਰਿ; ਭਾਗ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
The great, great Lord is found by great good fortune,
O Nanak, when, through the Guru, He bestows the Name. ॥4॥4॥56॥
I sing His glorious praises, and speak the Bani of His virtues;
as Gurmukh, I chant and recite the Lord's glorious praises. ॥1॥
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
Chanting and meditating on the Name, my mind has become blissful.
ਸਤਿ. ਸਤਿ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ; ਰਸਿ ਗਾਏ, ਗੁਣ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The True Guru has implanted within me the True Name, "True, True"; with love I sing the praises of the Lord of supreme bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਗਾ ॥
The humble servants of the Lord sing His glorious praises.
By great good fortune, they obtain the detached Lord. ॥2॥
Those without virtue hold on to the filth of Maya.
Without virtue, the egotistical are born only to die. ॥3॥
The Guru has revealed the Lord's virtues within the pool of the body.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh churns it, and extracts the essence. ॥4॥5॥57॥
I listen to the Name; the Name alone is pleasing to my mind.
By great good fortune, the Gurmukh obtains the Lord. ॥1॥
Chant the Name as Gurmukh, and be illumined.
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ. ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Name, I have no other support; the Name is woven into my every breath and morsel of food. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Since I heard the Name, it has become pleasing to my mind.
ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
One who recites the Name to me is my friend and companion. ॥2॥
Without the Name, the fools depart empty-handed.
ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ; ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
Like the moth gazing at the flame, they are consumed by the poison of Maya and die. ॥3॥
He Himself establishes, and having established, He disestablishes.
O Nanak, the Lord Himself gives the Name. ॥4॥6॥58॥
The Gurmukhs have made the vine of the Lord's Name grow within.
It bears the fruit of the Lord, so very sweet to the taste. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ; ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥
Chant the Name of the Lord, Master of endless waves.
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਮਾਰਿਆ ਕਾਲੁ. ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Chanting the Name again and again, praise Him through the Guru's teaching; thus death, the messengers of death and the serpent of the mind are slain. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
The Lord has placed devotion to Himself within the Guru.
ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਵੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
When the Guru is pleased, He gives it to the Sikh, O my brother. ॥2॥
ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ; ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
One who acts in ego knows nothing of the way of devotion.
ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਨਾਇ; ਖਾਕੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
He is like the elephant that bathes, and then throws dust on its head. ॥3॥
ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ; ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ॥
If one's destiny is great and very lofty,
O Nanak, one chants the Name, and becomes pure, absorbed in the True One. ॥4॥7॥59॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ; ਮਨਿ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
My mind hungers for the Name of the Lord.
ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਨਿਐ. ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
Hearing the Name, my mind is satisfied, O my brother. ॥1॥
Chant the Name, O my Sikhs of the Guru, O my friends.
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ. ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ, ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Chant the Name, and through the Name find peace; through the Guru's teaching, keep the Name enshrined in your mind and consciousness. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Hearing the Name, nothing but the Name, the mind is kept green and flourishing.
Earning the profit of the Name through the Guru's teaching, the mind blossoms forth. ॥2॥
Without the Name, the mortal is like a leper, blinded by attachment.
ਸਭ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ; ਦੁਖੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੩॥
All his actions are fruitless; they bring him only pain and entanglement. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ; ਜਪੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Very fortunate is the one who chants the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
O Nanak, through the Guru's teaching, he is lovingly attuned to the Name. ॥4॥8॥60॥
368: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਥਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ; ਥੋਥਰ ਵਾਜੈ ਬੇਨ ॥
The Yogi holds the instrument in his hand and plays its string, but his playing is hollow and empty.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੇਨ ॥੧॥
O Yogi, through the Guru's teaching, sing the glorious praises of the Lord, and this mind shall be drenched in the Lord's love. ॥1॥
O Yogi, give your intellect the teaching of the Lord's Name.
ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਹਮ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Throughout the ages, the One Lord is pervading; I bow in humility before Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਗ. ਭਾਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ, ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲ ॥
They sing ragas and say so many words, but this mind plays its own games.
ਜੋਵਹਿ ਕੂਪ. ਸਿੰਚਨ ਕਉ ਬਸੁਧਾ; ਉਠਿ ਬੈਲ ਗਏ ਚਰਿ ਬੇਲ ॥੨॥
They work the well to irrigate the fields, but the oxen have got up and gone to graze on the vines. ॥2॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ. ਕਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਵਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਜਾਮੈ, ਹਰਿਆ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
In the field of the body, sow the deeds of the Lord's Name, and the Lord shall sprout, a lush green field.
ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਬੈਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਵਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜੇਤੁ ॥੩॥
Make the mind steady, and yoke the mind as the ox; irrigate it with the Lord's Name through the Guru's teaching. ॥3॥
ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ; ਜੋ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਚੇਲ ॥
The Yogis, the wandering Jangams and the whole world are Yours, O Lord; whatever understanding You give them, that way they go.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ; ਹਰਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੇਲ ॥੪॥੯॥੬੧॥
O God of servant Nanak, Inner-knower of hearts, please urge my mind on and attach it to Yourself. ॥4॥9॥61॥
ਕਬ ਕੋ ਭਾਲੈ. ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਤਾਲਾ; ਕਬ ਕੋ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਰਬਾਬੁ ॥
Why should anyone go looking for bells and cymbals? Why should anyone play the rabaab?
ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਾਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਹਉ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਮਾਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
Going and coming takes some time; for that much time, I would rather remember the Name. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ; ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Such devotion has welled up in my mind,
ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ; ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ. ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that I cannot live without the Lord, even for an instant; like the fish, which dies without water. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਬ ਕੋਊ. ਮੇਲੈ ਪੰਚ ਸਤ ਗਾਇਣ; ਕਬ ਕੋ. ਰਾਗ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਠਾਵੈ ॥
Why should anyone tune the five strings and the seven notes to sing? Why should anyone raise the tune of a raga?
ਮੇਲਤ ਚੁਨਤ, ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤਬ ਲਗੁ. ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ, ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Tuning them and raising the tune takes a moment's time; for that much time, my mind would sing the Lord's praises. ॥2॥
ਕਬ ਕੋ ਨਾਚੈ ਪਾਵ ਪਸਾਰੈ; ਕਬ ਕੋ ਹਾਥ ਪਸਾਰੈ ॥
Why should anyone dance, stretching out his feet, and stretching out his hands?
ਹਾਥ ਪਾਵ ਪਸਾਰਤ, ਬਿਲਮੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤਬ ਲਗੁ. ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
Stretching out hands and feet takes a moment's delay; for that much time, my mind would remember the Lord. ॥3॥
ਕਬ ਕੋਊ, ਲੋਗਨ ਕਉ ਪਤੀਆਵੈ; ਲੋਕਿ ਪਤੀਣੈ, ਨਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Why should anyone try to convince people? Even when people are convinced, no honour is gained.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ; ਤਾ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੨॥
O servant Nanak, meditate forever on the Lord in your heart; then everyone will acclaim you. ॥4॥10॥62॥
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Join the True Congregation of the Lord's Holy Guru; joining the congregation, sing the Lord's glorious praises.
ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ. ਬਲਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ; ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
The jewel of spiritual wisdom shines, and the heart is illumined; the darkness of ignorance departs. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਚਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
O humble servants of the Lord, let your dance be meditation on the Lord, Har, Har.
ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ; ਹਮ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
If only I could meet such Saints, O my brother; I would wash the feet of such humble servants. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; night and day, attune yourself to the Lord.
ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਖ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
You shall obtain whatever fruit you desire, and hunger for Maya shall never come to you again. ॥2॥
ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
The infinite Lord Himself is the Creator; the Lord Himself speaks, and causes all to speak.
ਸੇਈ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ, ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ; ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ. ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
Those Saints are good, who are pleasing to You, O Lord; their honour is accepted at Your door. ॥3॥
ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਆਖਿ ਨ ਰਾਜੈ, ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ; ਜਿਉ ਆਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Nanak is never satisfied chanting the Lord's glorious praises; the more he chants them, the more he is at peace.
ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ. ਦੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕੁ. ਵਣਜਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੬੩॥
The Lord Himself has given the treasures of devotion; only the customer of these virtues trades in them and takes them along. ॥4॥11॥63॥
369: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕੇ ਕਾਫੀ, ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Asa Kafi · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 8
Death comes, ordained from the very beginning, yet in ego people weep.
Meditating on the Name as Gurmukh, one becomes steady. ॥1॥
Blessed is the perfect Guru, through whom they understood that they must depart.
ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ, ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
They earned the sublime profit of the Name, and remain absorbed in the Word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਡੇਹ; ਸਿ ਆਏ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
According to the days written for them by their past deeds, they came into this world, O mother;
ਚਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲੑਿ; ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
and by the Primal Lord's order, they must depart, today or tomorrow. ॥2॥
ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ; ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Useless is the life of those who have forgotten the Name.
ਜੂਐ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਜਗਿ; ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
They play the game of gambling in this world, and lose this mind. ॥3॥
ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ; ਜਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Those who have found the Guru are at peace, in life and in death.
O Nanak, they remain absorbed in the Truest of the true, and become one with the True Lord. ॥4॥12॥64॥
Having obtained the treasure of this human birth, they meditated on the Name.
By the Guru's grace, they understood, and were absorbed in the True Lord. ॥1॥
ਜਿਨੑ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ; ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Those who have such preordained destiny practise the Name.
ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ; ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
At the Gate of the True Lord, they are found truthful, and they are summoned to the Mansion of His presence. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The treasure of the Name is deep within; it is obtained by becoming Gurmukh.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
So, night and day, meditate on the Name, and sing the glorious praises of the Lord. ॥2॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੇਕ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Deep within are countless treasures, but the self-willed one does not find them.
In ego, he is proud of his pride, and is himself led astray. ॥3॥
O Nanak, he himself, all by himself, is led astray.
Through the Guru's teaching, the mind is illumined, and the True Lord is found. ॥4॥13॥65॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੬ ਕੇ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸੁਧੰਗ ॥
Asavari Sudhang · Guru Ram Das · Ghar 16
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
Night and day, I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Name.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ; ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ, ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ. ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The True Guru has revealed to me the Lord's Name; without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਮਰੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੁ. ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ; ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ, ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ॥
Hearing and remembering the Lord's praises is my capital; without the Lord, I cannot live, even for a moment.
ਜੈਸੇ ਹੰਸੁ. ਸਰਵਰ ਬਿਨੁ, ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ; ਤੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ, ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ॥੧॥
As the swan cannot live without the lake, how can the Lord's servant live without serving Him? ॥1॥
ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ, ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਰਿਦ ਧਾਰਿ; ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਮੋਹ ਅਪਮਾਨ ॥
Some enshrine the love of duality in their hearts; some enshrine love for worldly attachment and pride.
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ, ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੬੬॥
The Lord's humble servant embraces love for the Lord and the state of desirelessness; O Nanak, they meditate on the Lord God. ॥2॥14॥66॥
ਮਾਈ. ਮੋਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ; ਬਤਾਵਹੁ. ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
O mother, tell me where my Beloved Lord is, O my mother.
ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ, ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ; ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਹਲੁ ਬੇਲਿ ਰੀਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Lord, I cannot live for a moment or an instant; I delight in Him as the young camel delights in the vines. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਮਰਾ ਮਨੁ. ਬੈਰਾਗ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਭਇਓ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਮੀਤ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
My mind has become restless and detached from the world, longing for the vision of my Friend, the Lord.
ਜੈਸੇ ਅਲਿ. ਕਮਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ; ਤੈਸੇ. ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
As the bumblebee cannot live without the lotus, so I cannot live without the Lord. ॥1॥
370: ਰਾਖੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ, ਹਰਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Keep me in Your sanctuary, O Beloved Lord of the world; fulfil my longing, O Lord, Master of the earth.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ. ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ. ਨਿਮਖ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੧੫॥੬੭॥
Servant Nanak's mind is filled with bliss when the Lord grants the vision of His Darshan, even for an instant. ॥2॥39॥13॥15॥67॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
One who loves Maya is in turn eaten up by her.
ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬੈਠਾਲੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
One who seats her in comfort is greatly terrified by her.
Brothers, friends and family quarrel when they behold her.
But she has come under my control, by the Guru's grace. ॥1॥
ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਨੁਖਾ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ. ਸਭਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹਨਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the seekers, the Siddhas, the gods and mortals; all except the Holy are deceived by her deception. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ; ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
Some wander as renunciates, but they are engrossed in sexual desire.
ਇਕਿ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਗਿਰਹੀ; ਤਿਨੑ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਪੈ ॥
Some grow rich as householders, but she does not become their own.
ਇਕਿ ਸਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ; ਤਿਨੑ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਲਪਾਵੈ ॥
Some call themselves men of charity, and she torments them terribly.
ਹਮ. ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਲਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
The Lord has saved me, by attaching me to the feet of the True Guru. ॥2॥
She leads astray the penitents who practise penance.
The scholarly Pandits are all seduced by greed.
The world of the three qualities is enticed, and the heavens are enticed.
ਹਮ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਰਾਖੇ; ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥੩॥
The True Guru has saved me, giving me His hand. ॥3॥
She serves as a slave to the one who is spiritually wise.
With palms pressed together, she serves him and offers her prayer:
ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਹਹਿ; ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
"Whatever you say, that is what I shall do."
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨੇੜਿ; ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
O servant Nanak, she says, "I shall not draw near the Gurmukh." ॥4॥1॥
My Husband Lord has separated me from my mother-in-law, ignorance.
My sisters-in-law, hope and desire, have died of grief and anguish.
ਘਰ ਕੇ ਜਿਠੇਰੇ ਕੀ; ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
The domination of the elder brother-in-law, the Righteous Judge, is over.
My wise and all-knowing Husband Lord has saved me. ॥1॥
ਸੁਨਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ; ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Listen, O people: I have tasted the essence of love.
ਦੁਰਜਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਵੈਰੀ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The evil ones are dead, and my enemies destroyed; the True Guru has given me the Name of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
First, I renounced the love of ego.
Second, I renounced the ways of the world.
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਆਗਿ; ਦੁਰਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
Renouncing the three qualities, I look upon friend and enemy alike.
Meeting the Holy Guru, I have come to know the fourth state. ॥2॥
In the cave of intuitive peace, I have taken my seat.
The unstruck melody of the Lord, embodiment of light, plays within.
I am in great bliss, contemplating the Word of the Guru.
ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ; ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Blessed is the happy soul-bride, imbued with her Beloved. ॥3॥
Servant Nanak speaks the contemplation of God.
ਜੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਸੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Whoever listens and practises it is carried across.
ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਆਵੈ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
He is not born, nor does he die; he does not come or go.
He remains absorbed in the Lord. ॥4॥2॥
Devotion that serves the soul is like a bride of gentle nature,
incomparable in beauty, and perfect in conduct.
ਜਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤਾ ॥
The house in which she dwells is a glorious house,
but how rare is the one who, as Gurmukh, obtains her! ॥1॥
ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ; ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ. ਹਮ ਪਾਈ ॥
Meeting the Guru, I have obtained the bride of noble deeds,
